purpose: Add the module-owned task projection, processed event receipt, and source-command idempotency tables.
applicationCompatibility: Additive; existing applications are unaffected until Task Center is composed.
lockImpact: Creates a new schema, tables, and indexes only; no existing application table is locked.
backfill: None required. Authoritative sources can replay lifecycle events after composition.
recovery: Before consumers start, restore the pre-deployment backup. After use, retain accepted command receipts and forward-fix; projections can be rebuilt from authoritative source events. Expired running command leases are atomically taken over and redriven with the unchanged source idempotency key after interruption.
forwardFix: Append a new globally numbered migration. Never modify this migration after deployment.
